stories.headline: Horoscope for Sunday, 09/13/26 by Christopher Renstrom - sfgate.com
stories.summary: LEO (July 22 - Aug. 21): Good Fortune comes through others today. It could be a helpful tip or a lump sum from a long lost relative. Be on your best behavior.
stories.why: Not applicable — astrology content has no cultural significance for this demographic.

stories.headline: 'Misty Green' Review: Rosalind Eleazar Stars In Chris Rock Movie - Deadline
stories.summary: A review of Misty Green, writer-director Chris Rock's portrait of a down-and-out TV star played to the hilt by Rosalind Eleazar.
stories.why: Chris Rock's directorial debut signals a major pivot from comedian to serious filmmaker, testing whether he can reshape his public image post-slap controversy through prestige drama.

stories.headline: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother Review - ign.com
stories.summary: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother review: Mahershala Ali joins his would-be Blade director as a devout sword-wielding assassin.
stories.why: Mahershala Ali joining a Blade film after the MCU's failed attempts shows a A-list actor betting on Marvel's ability to course-correct, with major implications for superhero franchise trust.

stories.headline: Anthony Ippolito on Speaking to Sylvester Stallone Before Filming ‘I Play Rocky’: “Very Overwhelming and Daunting” - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: "It was a lot to take in because I'd spent over a year, by that point, studying him,” the actor said at THR‘s Studio at 1 Hotel during TIFF, presented by sponsor Canada Goose.
stories.why: A young actor getting his Rocky moment represents the rare opportunity to inherit a generational icon — this is about whether he can carry legacy weight without being crushed by it.

stories.headline: Critics celebrate Céline Dion's 'high-stakes' comeback show in Paris - BBC
stories.summary: The iconic Canadian singer kicked off her long-awaited comeback show in Paris on Saturday, after a six-year hiatus due to health issues.
stories.why: Céline Dion's return after neurological illness that nearly ended her career is a comeback narrative that redefines resilience; it shows a woman reclaiming her power on her own timeline.

stories.headline: 'NAZA' Review: Doc Accuses Israel Of Using AI To Kill Gaza Civilians - Deadline
stories.summary: 'Naza' Review: Documentary by Oscar winners Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor accuses Israel's military of using AI to kill Palestinian civilians in Gaza.
stories.why: An Oscar-winning doc accusing Israel of AI-enabled civilian kills forces men in this age group to confront how technology enables warfare and moral complicity in real time.

stories.headline: 'Reacher' star Alan Ritchson and wife Catherine splitting up after 2 decades of marriage - Fox News
stories.summary: Alan Ritchson and wife Catherine announced their split after 20 years of marriage, vowing to co-parent their three sons with grace and friendship.
stories.why: Alan Ritchson's split after 20 years challenges the 'action hero with stable family' archetype — it signals that even the most grounded masculine figures aren't immune to marriage dissolution.

stories.headline: 'Babies’ Is A Witty, Heartfelt Exploration Of Childless Adulthood - Deadline
stories.summary: After years of fielding questions about whether she wants to be a mom, Lauren Miller Rogen gives the definitive answer in the form of 'Babies'.
stories.why: Lauren Miller Rogen's 'Babies' film makes childlessness a comedic, deliberate choice rather than a tragedy — validating a lifestyle increasingly chosen by men this age without shame or defensiveness.
